title: Are Mythos' cyber capabilities overhyped? (epoch_ai, 2026-06-11)
abstract:
Corpus sentences naming Cybench (system-card corpus docs.sqlite, document slug in brackets):
[epoch-ai-claude-mythos-5-independent-eval] The results can be fully obtained using: - GPT 5.1-codex-max system card for GPT 5-codex and GPT 5.1-codex-max - GPT 5.4 system card for GPT 5.2-codex - GPT 5.5 system card for GPT 5.3-codex, GPT 5.4, and GPT 5.5 Cybench Description: Cybench is a benchmark containing 40 professional-level Capture the Flag (CTF) tasks from 4 distinct CTF competitions, chosen to be recent (as of 2024), meaningful, and spanning a wide range of difficulties.
[epoch-ai-claude-mythos-5-independent-eval] Moreover, Mythos Preview essentially saturates Cybench and CyberGym.
